item.text: Hi, could we consider choosing a route with more benches for our next walk? A path with regular places to sit would make the outing more comfortable and welcoming for participants with different ages, energy levels, mobility needs, or health considerations. Benches would also give everyone opportunities to pause, enjoy the surroundings, and chat without feeling rushed. I think this small adjustment could help more people participate confidently and make the walk a pleasant experience for the whole group.
